arguments.prompt:
Revise Spend Review into one authenticated persistent app. Use the agreed pre-revision demo source from Arrusted PR #1500, head d186c659629430e1d6c8dce9575cdc30bdc20087, as the application baseline, while using the newly implemented shared Arrusted runtime capabilities. Establish that baseline through your public source workflow. Do not use the later manually authored production PR as your implementation or comparison input. If the public source workflow cannot establish this combination, report the exact blocker before claiming a qualifying revision.

Remove .config/production-handoff.json, retire the local product demo, demo seeds, synthetic actor, reset control, production form flags and duplicate production modules. Use ordinary page/data/actions names and server/context.ts. Derive verified session, organization, app assignment, role, checked release and database scope without a VERCEL=1 gate. Requesters submit and view their own requests; reviewers review the queue and decide. Deny self-approval. Retain full audited history, including concurrent decisions and idempotent request submission. Page the queue and audit history with cursors. Compile a new immutable checked release and package only its required runtime files.

Builder authors all app changes, schema and tests; Builder prepares its database and real Auth identities, including requester/reviewer actors and a second tenant. Test browser submission and independent readback after reload, application restart and a new native Preview deployment; roles, revocation, isolation, forged actor/scope rejection, idempotency, concurrency, complete history and self-approval denial. Prove populated predecessor upgrade and failed-upgrade recovery. Discover and verify the authenticated schema receipt behavior directly. Run app, database policy and deployment policy checks and exact-head CI. Retain public transcript, authored changes, release/environment evidence and PR provenance. Open a draft PR after publication approval.

Keep the one-organization pilot, operator review and separate activation gates. Production activation is outside this request. Report acceptance as passed, failed, blocked or unassessed; no manual evaluator repair can replace a Builder capability.
